correctness.rationale: For an omitted vertex in part V_i, the only possible geodesic on which it can be internal has two selected endpoints in one different part V_j; this gives the iff criterion directly. The zero/one/two-or-more heavy-part partition then yields the polynomial algebraically. An explicit shortest-path verifier exhaustively confirms the criterion, coefficients, and minimum corollary on all tested complete multipartite profiles.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: None of the inspected prior statements implies the exact ordinary all-set criterion. A minimum algorithm returns one cardinality, while the new criterion determines membership for every subset and hence every polynomial coefficient. Strong geodetic coverage is non-equivalent because it fixes one geodesic per selected pair.
